title: Advanced Spark modeling: likelihoods, autodiff and engine internals
summary: A 38-chapter worked route through distributed custom likelihoods, Scala extension mechanisms, Spark/Torch execution and the boundaries of Spark/TMB modeling.
introduction: Start after the Scala/Spark foundation route. Mathematical bridges explain the exact objective before a distributed implementation. Public Spark examples use tiny deterministic CPU data; combined Torch/TMB and Catalyst projects have explicit preparation and evidence requirements. Reading a guide or running a reference does not establish mastery or cluster-scale performance.
